page.notes: The Arabic lines are read from a small, low-resolution scan and are not certain letter by letter: the Arabic of the second paragraph (the poem line beginning شاعرا and the line ending اسر اطلق), the word after "Periit" (أودى عتيب) and the last Arabic line (أذا كبر صبياننا...) may contain errors. The word after "Ille" is also doubtful. The sentence "Dictérium" is printed with an accent in the scan and may be "Dicterium". The Latin spelling "cùm curso" should be checked against "cursu" in the scan. The Arabic line at the foot ends with "omnes" printed beside the signature "Y y". No running head or catchword is visible.
